scenario.name: CERT-UA #4435, ESET & CISA ICS — Industroyer2 IEC 60870-5-104 Substation Telecontrol & Protection Relay Forensics
scenario.overview: Imagine a rogue dispatcher breaking into a regional electrical substation control booth during a night shift. First, they lock the legitimate chief operator out of the radio room and hide the official control handset so nobody can override their orders. Next, they open a direct dedicated hotline to every high-voltage breaker cabinet along the grid and flip the heavy circuit switches off one by one from a prewritten target list. In this scenario (T1489, CERT-UA #4435, ESET & CISA ICS, Industroyer2 IEC 60870-5-104 Substation Telecontrol & Protection Relay Forensics), the attacker follows one continuous intrusion path so each later Step can show the exact handoff that makes the next stage possible. The attack unfolds in one continuous arc: legitimate SCADA Service Termination Prior, then iEC 60870-5-104 STARTDT_ACT Handshake, then aSDU Type 46 IOA Telecontrol Frame Audit. Steps #1–#3 walk that chain end-to-end by covering Legitimate SCADA Service Termination Prior, then IEC 60870-5-104 STARTDT_ACT Handshake, then ASDU Type 46 IOA Telecontrol Frame Audit, while the Process Hierarchy tab keeps the Parent → Child spawn tree visible so you can see which trusted process launched the next payload. Primary detection correlates Sysmon Event 1 with the documented host and network chain.

stages.title: Stage 1: Legitimate SCADA Service Termination (PServiceControl.exe) Prior to Port 2404 Takeover
stages.subtitle: Impact (T1489 - Service Stop)
stages.description: Stepping inside the substation control booth, the rogue dispatcher first shuts down the legitimate chief operator’s console and moves their official radio handset out of reach so the real control desk cannot fight back once the breaker orders begin. Before opening its own IEC-104 socket connections, the Industroyer2 executable terminates the legitimate substation telecontrol service (PServiceControl.exe) and renames its binary on disk so the legitimate SCADA master cannot override the rogue commands (logged in Sysmon Event 1 with ParentBinary=C:\Temp\108_100.exe , Industroyer2 Binary, StoppedServiceBinary=PServiceControl.exe , Substation SCADA Service, CertUaReference=CERT-UA#4435 so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). Under the hood, the observed step executes taskkill.exe /F /IM PServiceControl.exe (which executes the technical command / telemetry directive , taskkill.exe /F /IM PServiceControl.exe via taskkill.exe, passing the exact arguments, targe so that advances the scenario kill-chain under MITRE T1489 during "Legitimate SCADA Service Termination , PServiceControl.exe Prior to Port 2404 Takeover" , Before opening its own IEC-104 socket connections, the Industroyer2 executable terminates the legitimate substation telecontrol service , PServiceControl while generating verifiable host or network telemetry for DFIR attribution). Next, the follow-up artifact cmd.exe /c move C:\SCADA\bin\PServiceControl.exe C:\SCADA\bin\PServiceControl.exe.bak runs (which executes the technical command / telemetry directive , cmd.exe /c move C:\SCADA\bin\PServiceControl.exe C:\SCADA\bin\PServiceControl.exe.bak via cm so that advances the scenario kill-chain under MITRE T1489 during "Legitimate SCADA Service Termination , PServiceControl.exe Prior to Port 2404 Takeover" , Before opening its own IEC-104 socket connections, the Industroyer2 executable terminates the legitimate substation telecontrol service , PServiceControl while generating verifiable host or network telemetry for DFIR attribution). stages.title: Stage 2: IEC 60870-5-104 STARTDT_ACT Handshake & Interrogation Frame on TCP Port 2404
stages.subtitle: Command and Control (T1071 - Application Layer Protocol / IEC 60870-5-104)
stages.description: Reading from a laminated card of substation phone numbers tucked in their pocket, the rogue dispatcher dials each remote breaker cabinet over the dedicated utility line and sends the official wake-up chime that puts every relay on standby for live commands. The binary reads its embedded configuration table (containing target RTU IP addresses, Common Address of ASDU, and IOA lists) and sends an IEC-104 U-format STARTDT_ACT (0x68 0x04 0x07 0x00 0x00 0x00) control frame over TCP port 2404 to activate data transfer with each substation RTU (logged in Network Event 2404 with Protocol=IEC 60870-5-104 , TCP 2404, ApciControlFrame=STARTDT_ACT , Start Data Transfer Activation, AsduType100=C_IC_NA_1 , Interrogation Command so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). stages.title: Stage 3: ASDU Type 46 (C_DC_NA_1 Double Command) IOA Telecontrol Frame Audit
stages.subtitle: Impact (T1565.002 - Transmitted Data Manipulation / IEC-104 Telecontrol)
stages.description: As soon as the remote cabinets chime back ready, the rogue dispatcher marches straight down the laminated list, throwing switch after switch to trip the high-voltage breakers open and darken the substation feeders. After receiving STARTDT_CON, the binary iterates through its configured Information Object Addresses (IOAs) and transmits ASDU Type 45 (C_SC_NA_1 Single Command) and Type 46 (C_DC_NA_1 Double Command) frames with Cause of Transmission = 6 (Activation) to toggle telecontrol state points (logged in IDS Alert Event 46 with AsduTypeId=46 , C_DC_NA_1, Double Command, CauseOfTransmission=6 , Activation, InformationObjectAddress=COA=12, IOA=1104 so analysts can verify the exact actor and target artifact). Under the hood, the observed step executes tshark -r substation.pcap -Y "iec60870_asdu.typeid == 45 || iec60870_asdu.typeid == 46" -T fields -e iec60870_asdu.ca -e iec60870_asdu.ioa (which Captures or inspects industrial control system , ICS/OT protocol frames and engineering workstation logs , tshark -r substation.pcap -Y "iec60870_a so that reconstructs PLC logic transfers, substation breaker telecontrol commands, or Safety Instrumented System , SIS controller state changes , T1565.002 during "ASDU Type 46 , C_DC_NA_1 Double Command IOA Telecontrol Frame Audit"). On the diagram, follow Step #3 / Link #3 (#3→ IEC-104 ASDU Type 46 (C_DC_NA_1 Double Command) COA=12 IOA=1104COT=6 (Activation) / ⇠#3 ALERT 46) from Node ③ (#3 Substation Gateway (:2404)) to Node ④ (#4 Substation RTU & Bay Controller), monitored by Node ⑥ (#6 PServiceControl Legitimate Service).
